decision.reason: [ev-9365c607d0c4] is a single changelog line, "Fix ServerUp metric (#9534)". It names the metric but doesn't say what was wrong with it or how it behaves after the fix. It also doesn't say which setups were affected (for example, which metrics backend or configuration) or what happens to an operator who does nothing. To fill in the change, applicability and consequence, we need the content of PR #9534 or a description of the before and after behaviour.
